entries.description: Encode self-contained HTML pages into shareable URLs. anew_write (HTML → URL) and anew_read (URL → HTML) over streamable HTTP at https://anew.page/mcp, no auth.
representativeQueries: publish this HTML as a shareable link
turn my HTML page into a URL without hosting it anywhere
read the HTML source behind an anew.page link
edit a page I already have an anew.page URL for

entries.description: Encode self-contained HTML pages into shareable URLs. A2A 1.0 JSON-RPC at https://anew.page/a2a/v1: send HTML, get the page URL back — or send an anew.page URL, get its HTML.
representativeQueries: ask another agent to publish this page for me
make a one-page website from this HTML
decode an anew.page URL back into its HTML

entries.description: Encode self-contained HTML pages into shareable URLs. POST raw HTML to https://anew.page/write and the 200 body is the finished page URL; GET a page URL with Accept: text/plain for its source.
representativeQueries: POST HTML somewhere and get a permanent link back
create a one-page site with a single curl command
host a small HTML page for free with no signup

entries.description: Encode self-contained HTML pages into anew.page URLs, and read the HTML back out of one. Use when a user wants to publish a one-page site or a redirect, or to edit a page they already have a URL for.
representativeQueries: how do I write anew.page URLs
teach me to encode an HTML page into a shareable URL
read an anew.page URL back so I can edit the page
